basics.name: Junteng Liu
basics.label: Ph.D. candidate in Computer Science, HKUST NLP Group
basics.summary: First-year PhD candidate at the HKUST NLP Group. My research focuses on natural language processing and machine learning, on large language model reasoning and reinforcement learning, on LLM truthfulness and interpretability, and on hallucination in vision-language models.

education.institution: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST), HKUST NLP Group
